items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: he played a thing with Louis Young, so he passed away. Edmund Hall? Edmund Hall, he was a very good clarinet player, I liked him very much.

ctx.x: Yeah. What saxophone or clarinet players were there around in the early days, besides Sidney Bechet, which you liked to listen to? Who else was there, you know, that you liked to listen to?

Well there wasn't anyone outside of Sidney Bechet on the saxophone, but now the clarinet players around, after Sidney then left was Hall. I forget Hall's name, he played a thing with Louis Young, so he passed away. Edmund Hall? Edmund Hall, he was a very good clarinet player, I liked him very much. I always liked the Rinder Theo's clarinet player very much. But Sidney Bechet, he was chief.
What bands did you hear Sidney work with? I mean, who was he playing with at this time, Sidney Bechet?
